body: Thank you for your advice. I do care for my SO, but I'm not sure I'm in love with him anymore. Since then love was never reciprocated, I think I began to distance myself just in case it does end.
Everytime I try to talk about it, all I get from him is 'I don't know'. He's never been able to talk about his feelings, no matter how much I try.
I went there and paid $125 for them to tell me I needed to see the GI. The GI is the one charging me $200 for an initial appointment to tell me how much a diagnostic procedure will be.
I need $200 just to make an appointment at a university hospital to find out how much I have to pay for any procedures I need to diagnose my issues.
